course.title: Probability and Statistical Analysis
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A shaft 100 mm in diameter that rotates at 30 Hz is subjected to bending loads that produce a maximum bending moment of 2500 π N.m. Determine the torque that can also act simultaneously on the shaft without exceeding a shearing stress τ = 80 Mpa or a normal stress σ = 100 Mpa. What is the maximum power that can be transmitted by the shaft?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
